This is a list of mouse shortcuts in Mozilla Firefox.{for linux} The shortcuts only work if they are not used by the desktop environment or window manager.{/for}
*For keyboard shortcuts, see [[Keyboard shortcuts - Perform common Firefox tasks quickly|this article]].

__TOC__

=Navigation=
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Go Back
|{for win,linux}{key Alt} + Scroll down{/for}{for mac}{key option} + Scroll down{/for}
|-
|Go Forward
|{for win,linux}{key Alt} + Scroll up{/for}{for mac}{key option} + Scroll up{/for}
|-
|Go Back or Forward but in a New Foreground Tab
|Middle-click the Back or Forward button<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key control}{/for} + Click the Back or Forward button
|-
|Go Back or Forward but in a New Background Tab
|{key Shift} + Middle-click the Back or Forward button<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Click the Back or Forward button
|-
|Go Back or Forward but in a New Window
|{key Shift} + Click the Back or Forward button
|-
|Reload Page (override cache)
|{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Click Reload button
|}

=Links=
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Open Link in Current Tab
|Left-click Link
|-
|Open Link in New Background Tab[[#fgbg|*]]
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for} + Left-click Link<br>Middle-click Link
|-
|Open Link in New Foreground Tab[[#fgbg|*]]
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Left-click Link<br>{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Middle-click Link
|-
|Open Link in New Window
|{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Left-click Link
|-
|Open Link or Selected URL in an Existing Tab
|Drag Link or Selected URL to Tab
|-
|Open Link or Selected URL in a New Background Tab beside an Existing Tab[[#fgbg|*]]
|Drag Link or Selected URL beside Existing Tab
|-
|Open Link or Selected URL in a New Foreground Tab beside an Existing Tab[[#fgbg|*]]
|{key Shift} + Drag Link or Selected URL beside Existing Tab
|-
|Save Link
|{for win,linux}{key Alt}{/for}{for mac}{key option}{/for} + Left-Click on Link<sup>1</sup><br>{for linux}{key Windows-Key+Alt} + Left-Click on Link<sup>1</sup><br>{/for}1) when {pref browser.altClickSave} is set to {pref true} (as in the [[Configuration Editor for Firefox|Configuration Editor]]), which is not the default.<br><br>Drag Link to Downloads Button
|}

<div id="fgbg" />
<nowiki>*</nowiki> These Open Foreground or Background Tab shortcuts will be switched if the setting '''When you open a link in a new tab, switch to it immediately''' is enabled in the [[Tab preferences and settings|General settings panel]].
[[Template:aboutconfigwarning]]

=Miscellaneous=
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Focus the Page
|Click the page or the movable (often darker) part of a scrollbar
|-
|Focus an input field
|Click the input field
|-
|Open an item's context menu
|Right-click the item {for mac} (or [[Template:contextmenu]] the item){/for}
|-
|Show an item's tooltip
|Put mouse cursor on the item
|}

=Scrolling a Page=
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Scroll
|Drag the movable (often darker) part of a scrollbar.<br>{for win}Click arrow at end of scroll bar.{/for}
|-
|Scroll down or up one Page
|{for win}Click under or over the movable (often darker) part of the vertical scrollbar{/for}{for linux}Right-Click or {key Shift} + Click under or over the movable (often darker) part of the vertical scrollbar.{/for}
|-
|Scroll to Clicked Position
|{for win}{key Shift} + Click non-movable (often lighter) part of scrollbar (not an arrow){/for}{for linux}Click non-movable (often lighter) part of scrollbar{/for}
|-
|Scroll Down
|Scroll down (on page or scrollbar)
|-
|Scroll Up
|Scroll up (on page or scrollbar)
|-
|Scroll Right
|{key Shift} + Scroll down (on page or scrollbar)
|-
|Scroll Left
|{key Shift} + Scroll up (on page or scrollbar)
|}

==Autoscrolling a Page==
This only works if the setting “Use autoscrolling” is enabled in the [[Change Firefox options, preferences and settings|Settings]].
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Autoscroll the Page
|Press and hold middle mouse button on page{for win} or scrollbar{/for}, and move mouse
|-
|Start Autoscroll Mode
|Middle-click on page{for win} or scrollbar{/for}
|-
|Scroll in Autoscroll Mode
|Move mouse
|-
|Stop Autoscroll Mode
|Click<br>Middle-click{for linux}<br>Right-click{/for}<br>Scroll
|}

{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Zoom In
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key control}{/for} + Scroll up
|-
|Zoom Out
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key control}{/for} + Scroll down
|-
|Reset Zoom to Default Zoom Level
|Click zoom level indicator on Address Bar (when zoom level is not the default)
|}

=Tabs=
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Close Tab
|Middle-click on Tab
|-
|Duplicate (Copy) Tab
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key option}{/for} + Drag Tab to Tab Bar
|-
|Duplicate (Copy) Current Tab in New Foreground Tab
|Middle-click on Reload button<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for} + Click on Reload button
|-
|Duplicate (Copy) Current Tab in New Background Tab
|{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Middle-click on Reload button<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Click on Reload button
|-
|Move Tab
|Drag Tab to Tab Bar (also between windows)
|-
|Move Tab to New Window
|Drag Tab to Address Bar or Page
|-
|Open New Foreground Tab on Right End of Tab Bar
|Click "New Tab" Button<br>Middle-click on Tab Bar<br>Double-click on Tab Bar (if title bar is shown)
|-
|Open New Foreground Tab to the Right of Current Tab
|Middle-Click “New Tab” Button<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for} + Click “New Tab” Button
|-
|Open New Background Tab to the Right of Current Tab
|{key Shift} + Middle-Click “New Tab” Button<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Click “New Tab” Button
|-
|Open New Tab in New Window
|{key Shift} + Click “New Tab” Button
|-
|Scroll the Tab Bar (when it does not show all tabs)
|Scroll on Tab Bar
|-
|Scroll the Tab Bar by one page (when it does not show all tabs)
|Double-Click the left or right arrow button on the tab bar
|-
|Scroll to Beginning or End of Tab Bar (when it does not show all tabs)
|Triple-Click the left or right arrow button on the tab bar
|}

==Selection of Multiple Tabs==
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Select a tab. Deselect all other tabs.
|Click the tab
|-
|Select or deselect a tab. The other tabs stay selected or deselected.
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for} + Click the tab
|-
|Select a tab and the most recently clicked or {for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for}-clicked selected tab and all tabs in between. Deselect all other tabs.
|{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Click the tab
|-
|Like above but the other tabs stay selected or deselected.
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Click the tab
|-
|Open two tabs in a [[Split View in Firefox|split view]].
|With the two tabs open, {for win,linux}{key Alt}{/for}{for mac}{key Option}{/for} while one tab is in focus then click the second tab
|}

=Bookmarks & History Pages=
{|
!'''Command'''
!'''Shortcut'''
|-
|Add Existing Tag to Bookmark
|Drag Bookmark to Tag in Library
|-
|Create Bookmark for Tab, Link, History Page or Selected URL
|Drag Tab, Link, History Page or Selected URL to Bookmarks Toolbar, Sidebar, Menu, or Library
|-
|Copy Bookmark or Folder
|{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key option}{/for} + Drag bookmark or folder to Bookmarks Toolbar, Sidebar, Menu, or Library
|-
|Move Bookmark or Folder
|Drag Bookmark or folder to Bookmarks Toolbar, Sidebar, Menu, or Library
|-
|Open Bookmark or History Page in Current Tab
|Left-click Bookmark or History Page (not in Library).<br>Double-click Bookmark or History Page (in Library).
|-
|Open Bookmark or History Page in New Foreground Tab
|Middle-click Bookmark or History Page<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for} + Left-click Bookmark or History Page (not in Library)<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for} + Double-click Bookmark or History Page (in Library)
|-
|Open Bookmark or History Page in New Background Tab
|{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Middle-click Bookmark or History Page<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Left-click Bookmark or History Page (not in Library)<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Double-click Bookmark or History Page (in Library)
|-
|Open Bookmark or History Page in New Window
|{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Left-click Bookmark or History Page (not in Library)<br>{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Double-click Bookmark or History Page (in Library)
|-
|Open Bookmark or History Page in an Existing Tab
|Drag Bookmark or History Page to Tab
|-
|Open Bookmark or History Page in a New Background Tab beside an Existing Tab[[#fgbg|*]]
|Drag Bookmark or History Page beside Existing Tab
|-
|Open Bookmark or History Page in a New Foreground Tab beside an Existing Tab[[#fgbg|*]]
|{key Shift} + Drag Bookmark or History Page beside Existing Tab
|-
|Open All Bookmarks of a Folder (not in Library) in New Tabs or a New Window (except those in subfolders)
|
New Tabs (first bookmark is opened in foreground tab):<br>Middle-click the bookmark folder<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key command}{/for} + Click the bookmark folder<br>

New Background Tabs:<br>{key Shift} + Middle-click the bookmark folder<br>{for win,linux}{key Ctrl+Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key command+shift}{/for} + Click the bookmark folder<br>

New Window:<br>{key Shift} + Click the bookmark folder
|-
|Open All Bookmarks of a Folder in New Tabs (except those in subfolders)
|
New Tabs (first bookmark is opened in foreground tab)[[#fgbg|*]]:<br>{for win,linux}{key Shift}{/for}{for mac}{key shift}{/for} + Drag Folder beside Tab<br>

New Background Tabs[[#fgbg|*]]:<br>Drag Folder beside Tab
|}
